Sphinx's Roar can paralyze all creatures within far range for up to 4 rounds, locking down entire parties.

GMs: Start with Roar to paralyze the party, then use Time Bend on the nearest threat to keep them frozen.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Making an Attack allows multiple actions to trigger an attack, not just the Attack action itself.

DMs: Clarify that making an attack includes the Attack action, certain Bonus Actions, and Reactions to avoid future disputes.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

Dwarf's Shield Brother action grants an adjacent ally +2 AC by body-blocking.

Judges: When your squishy wizard's about to get skewered, have the Dwarf use Shield Brother for that +2 AC buffer.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

Ras-Godai's Smoke Step allows three near teleports per day as a free action, catching players off guard.

GMs: Exploit Ras-Godai's Smoke Step to reposition and strike unaware foes with doubled damage; don't let them waste this early advantage.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Mother Of Night can drag a failed caster into The Nightfall, not just fizzle.

GMs: Only let them cast Mother Of Night when they have a plan for appeasing The Nightfall if they fail.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

Wererat's Bite attack can spread lycanthropy, a detail overlooked in combat planning.

DMs: Remind your players that a Wererat's Bite attack can spread lycanthropy, so keep them at range with its low Charisma save (-1).

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Armor-breaker Weapon destroys armor on any critical hit, removing the opponent's AC for the rest of the fight.

Judges: Aim for the toughest armor with the Armor-breaker Weapon; a crit strips their AC, making them easy prey.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Equipment Proficiencies determine which weapons and tools a character can use effectively without penalty.

DMs: Confirm each character's equipment proficiencies at creation to avoid penalties on attack rolls or checks later.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Ray of Enfeeblement requires at least 1 point of spellburn to cast, catching many wizards off guard.

Judges: Make them burn at least 1 point of spellburn and target the muscle-bound brute, not the cannon fodder.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Hat Of The Hound's transformation lasts only 10 rounds daily.

GMs: Hold the Hat Of The Hound's 10-round transformation for when a mastiff's speed or scent can turn the tide.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

Frame a Young Bronze Dragon encounter with a timer so the party must trade certainty for speed.

DMs: Remind players that the Young Bronze Dragon's Lightning Breath recharges on a 5-6; spread out to avoid a 60-foot line of 10d10 damage.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Hellthorn's tendril attack combines 1d6 damage with a grapple and poison sap that drains 1d4 Stamina.

Judges: Plant the Hellthorn in a narrow corridor; its 0' movement and tendrils will punish any fool who tries to rush past.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70
